text.card: A star about 110 parsecs away, 4.4 times the Sun's width, measured by Gaia.
text.introduction: Gaia's parallax, brightness and spectrum give it 4.4 solar radii and 1.80 solar masses (FLAME) and 5,253 K at its surface (GSP-Phot).

quotes.title: HD 212771
quotes.card: HD 212771, also named Lionrock, is a solitary star in the equatorial-southern zodiac constellation of Aquarius.
quotes.introduction: It has an apparent magnitude of 7.60, making it readily visible with binoculars but not the naked eye.
